filterName: Raw Document To Output Stream Step
overview: The Raw Document To Output Stream step copies the bytes of a raw document to a provided output stream. It is typically the last step in a pipeline that ends with a raw document and needs to be written somewhere other than a file on disk. After copying the content it consumes the raw-document event so nothing is forwarded to a following step.
processingNotes: Copies the raw document's stream verbatim to the destination output stream without interpreting or transforming the content.
Consumes (eats) the raw-document event after writing and emits a no-op event, so it should normally be the final step in the pipeline.
The destination output stream is supplied programmatically rather than through step parameters.
